messages:
olivia-finance: Quick flag — our cloud GPU line item spiked ~12% w/w in eu-west-1 and ~9% in us-west2. That moves unit cost for Hosted text gen from ~$2.10 per 1M tokens to ~ $2.35-$2.45 depending on region. Need a rapid read on margin impact + short list of mitigations. Anyone have the updated per-region cost breakdown?

raj-infra: Saw the vendor bulletin this morning — capacity surcharge for a few weeks in eu-west due to H100 demand + maintenance. We have some spot eviction churn and autoscale bumped fallback instances (higher cost).

sarah-fpa: Running quick scenario: baseline contribution margin for Hosted was 42% at $2.10. If blended cost increases to $2.40 avg, margin drops to ~31% (assuming no price change). If we absorb, ARR margin risk ~ -$1.2M/yr at current run-rate.

jess-ops: Important to separate Dedicated customers vs Hosted. Dedicated has reserved commits — many contracts lock rates, but new provisioning + burst capacity costs still leak into ops.

matt-eng: Immediate checks: 1) confirm which autoscale groups fell back to non-committed instances; 2) see if routing sent traffic to higher-cost zones. I can run a heatmap of instance types by region.

olivia-finance: @raj-infra @sarah-fpa can we get a 30-min sync with the pricing + product folks later today? Need options: raise price, carveouts for new customers, or engineering mitigations.

raj-infra: Quick technical mitigations that are low effort:
- tighten continuous-batching window (saves ~3-5% token cost)
- enable prefix/KV cache TTL tuning for non-sensitive tenants (saves 2-4%)
- prefer committed pools for background workloads (we can route low-priority generation to cheaper committed clusters)

raj-infra: Longer-term: renegotiate reserved capacity with provider for eu-west, and add cross-region fallbacks in service routing to use cheaper zones when latency budget allows.

sarah-fpa: I modeled three options (very rough):
1) absorb cost: margin -> 31%, cash impact negative ~1.2M/yr
2) +10% price for new Hosted accounts (grandfather existing): margin -> ~37% after adoption lag, adds ~0.9M/yr once fully onboarded
3) keep price, invest in infra efficiency (pipeline of optimizations we think net 6% unit cost): margin -> ~35%, saves ~0.5M/yr but needs engineering prioritization

jess-ops: Contract nuance: enterprise customers on Dedicated will push back on price changes. We should avoid unilateral rate changes there. For Hosted, a small increase for new signups + communication seems reasonable.

matt-eng: For a quick data pull, run this billing query (example):
```
aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-02-01,End=2026-02-28 --metrics UnblendedCost --filter file://gpu-regions-filter.json
```
Also check edge cases where autoscaler launched on-demand instances instead of reserved pools.

billing-bot: Billing alert: GPU spend above forecast by 11% for period 2026-02-25 -> 2026-03-03 (threshold triggered).

olivia-finance: Proposed immediate plan (today/tomorrow):
- infra: run region-level breakdown + autoscale incident root cause (matt/raj) — deliver by EOD today
- eng: quick toggles for batching and KV TTL where safe (matt) — aim for measurable save within 72h
- fp&a: finalize 2 pricing scenarios (new-hosted SKU + no change + efficiency offset) and communicate P&L impact (sarah) — by EOD tomorrow
- product/sales: prepare messaging for enterprise customers if price action needed (jess)

raj-infra: I'll also open a provider support ticket to clarify if surcharge is temporary and whether we can get a credit for capacity disruption.

sarah-fpa: I'll include sensitivity table in the deck: price delta vs margin vs churn risk. Early back-of-envelope suggests a 7-10% Hosted price bump mostly preserves margin without dramatic churn risk.

jess-ops: Operational ask: if we enable region fallback, make sure SLO tags are respected — don't route enterprise low-latency traffic to higher-latency cheap zones.

matt-eng: Noted. We'll gate fallback by route-level latency budget and customer tier.

olivia-finance: OK — let's meet 30-min at 16:30 UTC. If anyone has quick alternate ideas (e.g., faster quantization rollout, preemptible commitments) drop them here. :thinking_face:

raj-infra: One more: we can delay a non-critical Dedicated fleet expansion this quarter and shift some workloads to existing committed capacity. That recovers ~3% of cost hill for Q2.

sarah-fpa: Good. I'll bring the delta scenarios. Thanks all. :+1:

jess-ops: Thanks — will prep enterprise comms draft in case we go with pricing change.

matt-eng: Starting the region heatmap now, will post results in this thread when done.

billing-bot: Note: next automated cost forecast run in 4h.
